title: Deep-linkable Span Inspector and Compact Trace Lens
creator: Ava Chen
description: Problem: Operators frequently need to jump from high-level request dashboards into a focused trace view that is shareable and actionable. Current trace detail screens are heavyweight, not linkable at span-level, and are slow to scan for experiments (rollouts) or cost-impacting behaviors. Goal: design a compact "Compact Trace Lens" allowing fast identification of key spans, deep-linking to a specific span/correlation-id, and lightweight inline actions for troubleshooting and rollout diagnostics. This ticket covers the design prototype, interaction states, and handoff notes for engineering and PM review.
acceptance_criteria: A clickable permalink exists for request-level and span-level deep links and preserves filter context (time range, environment, rollout variant)
Compact Trace Lens renders a condensed span list (max 15 rows) with sparkline latency and error badges and expands to full timeline on demand
Sticky timeline scrubber persists while scrolling spans and highlights active KV cache hits and SLO waterline
Inline quick-actions available on spans: Capture Snapshot, Open Logs, Mark as Suspect, Link to Rollout Variant
Prototype vetted by PM, Eng, and SRE; design sign-off recorded and engineering tickets created for front-end and backend work
Permalink resolves in < 2s for traces with up to 500 spans (backend requirement noted in dependencies)
design_notes: Show 'correlation group' chips at the top to let users collapse all spans with the same correlation id across services
Use a condensed row layout with token-level heatmap on hover for heavy spans to save vertical space
Affinity to Rollouts: annotate spans generated by experimental variants and surface a 'variant delta' ribbon showing latency delta vs baseline
Expose filter bar with typed suggestions (service:, span:, correlation-id:, variant:) and support immediate-link copy
Performance tradeoff: initial render should stream first 50 spans and progressively hydrate remaining rows to avoid jank
Privacy: redact sensitive metadata by default; allow 'show sensitive fields' toggle requiring extra permission
review_feedback: Noah Patel (PM): prefer maintaining current deep-link param names for backwards compatibility; add rolloutVariant param
Samir Khan (Eng): backend must add trace-level indexing by correlation-id; suggested ENG-3024 to implement fast lookup
Priya Mehta (SRE): sticky scrubber ok, but ensure memory overhead for streaming is bounded; propose streaming + windowing approach
Mina Park (Design): request to explore a denser color palette for heatmap to aid color-blind users
decisions: Ship deep-linking using existing query params trace_id + span_id + context (time_range, env, variant)
Start with read-only quick-actions; implement actionable retries in a follow-up (security review required)
Compact Lens will be the default collapsed view in Console traces with a 'Expand to Full Trace' CTA
next_steps: Create ENG tickets for backend index endpoints (ENG-3024) and streaming API changes (ENG-2987)
Design to provide high-fidelity assets and accessibility spec by 2026-03-18
PM to confirm rollout-variant telemetry schema with Product Analytics
SRE to profile memory overhead on a 10k-span trace sample and report findings
notes: This design intentionally avoids cluttering the primary trace view; the Compact Lens is targeted at engineers performing rapid triage and platform owners verifying rollout effects. Front-end should support server-side pagination and client-side windowing. Follow security guidelines for permalink generation to avoid leaking tokens in URLs.
